title: Free writer build before checks disk gate; gate only before local run
summary: Retry of job 20261102-061427-anxh (dispatched, never verified, no findings). In check_and_verify the up-front disk_gate runs before free_producer_build, so the job's own writer build can hold it; move the gate after that removal and apply it only just before a local check run, so a CI-supplied result never triggers it. Audience: the Athena operator, who wants fewer false disk holds.

defaults_applied.how: Criteria check that the false hold no longer happens and that the local-run hold still does.
New tests in drain.rs cover both behaviors.
Criteria run the drain tests rather than checking that wiring exists.
The gate order is fixed, not the single job's symptom.
One focused change to the checks-stage gate.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Code survey: read crates/athena-core/src/run/mod.rs. check_and_verify calls disk_gate (about line 1414) when recorded_checks is none, before push_ci_branch. free_producer_build (called about line 1463, defined in crates/athena-core/src/run/checks.rs) runs later, in the Checks stage. disk_gate is in crates/athena-core/src/disk.rs. hold_for_disk is the existing hold path. Free disk is measured directly by the existing simulated-free-space hook in the drain tests, not through a stand-in. No record or data file is added, so the records allow-list is untouched (no check_record_file or AnyRecord change). The change adds no refusal rule beyond moving and narrowing an existing one, so it refuses fewer readings; expected 0% of newly refused readings.

Retry of job 20261102-061427-anxh: that job had no recorded findings and was not verified. Its candidate's 10 changed files are listed as deliverables (kept as a starting point and re-verified) except binary.rs, test_support.rs and run/tests.rs, which are also kept as optional deliverables because the candidate edited them for test support. docs/architecture.md is kept to describe the new gate placement.

The hold, when it still applies on the local-run path, behaves as today: it is committed with records and no outcome, and the next drain resumes it. Reusing the producer's approach (the first local exec calling the existing disk_gate) is allowed but not required.
Priority high is noted. The user's original constraint stands: no standalone repo-wide fmt, clippy or test acceptance criterion.

acceptance_criteria.text: A new test in crates/athena-cli/tests/drain.rs (using with_free_space and simulated_free) has a writer build whose size takes simulated free disk below min_free_gb. The job is not held for disk, the build directory is removed first, and the checks run to a verdict. Run `cargo test -p athena-cli --test drain` and check that it passes.

A new test with a GitHub origin and a green CI run for the candidate, with free disk below min_free_gb, shows the checks stage does not hold for low disk and prints the 'ci   checks reused' line. A companion case with no usable CI result shows the disk gate still holds the job before the local check run. Run `cargo test -p athena-cli --test drain` and check that both pass.

In crates/athena-core/src/run/mod.rs check_and_verify, the up-front disk_gate call before the checks is gone. free_producer_build runs before any disk_gate in the checks stage, and the gate is called only on the local-run path. Check by reading the diff.
CHANGELOG.md has a new entry saying the writer build is removed before the checks free-disk check and the requirement applies only before a local check run.

The verifier-stage gate (verifier_environment_problem) and the dispatch and producer gates are unchanged in the diff, and the existing disk-hold tests in crates/athena-cli/tests/drain.rs still pass (`cargo test -p athena-cli --test drain`).
docs/architecture.md, if it describes the checks-stage disk check, states the new order; no other claim there changes.

out_of_scope: Changing the dispatch, producer or verifier-stage disk gates
Changing the min_free_gb default or config
Changing CI-result resolution or routing rules
Governance files such as athena.toml, defaults.toml and workflow files
departures: Slightly lower verification pass chance: the prior attempt was never verified, and moving a gate onto the local-run path touches several files.
urgent_reason: Cuts false disk holds, which waste time on stalled jobs and redo work.
hard_reason: Changes where a rule that can hold work (the checks-stage free-disk gate) runs in the run pipeline, so a mistake is costly and hard to see.
